description: Look up current WHOIS / RDAP registration data for a single domain — registrar, creation/expiry/updated dates, nameservers, status codes, and contact info when not redacted. Use this as the first move when triaging an unknown or suspicious domain. Do NOT use this when you need historical ownership changes (use `whois_history`) or when you have many domains in a list (use `bulk_whois`).

fetch_whois_from_registry_only.description: If true, returns only registry WHOIS data, not registrar data.

force_refresh.description: If true, forces hard refresh. Costs 5 API calls.

get_host_ip_whois_on_no_domain_data.description: If true, returns host IP WHOIS when domain WHOIS is unavailable.

get_registrar_proxy_data.description: If true, includes registrar WHOIS proxy info in "privateWhoisProxy".

include_domain_availability.description: If true, includes domain availability status.

include_ip_for_domain_queried.description: If true, includes hosting IP address for the domain.

parse_registrar_raw_text.description: If true, provides parsed format for registrar information.

parse_registry_raw_text.description: If true, provides parsed format for registry information.

prefer_refresh_even_if_incomplete.description: If true, provides most up-to-date but potentially incomplete data.

query_type.description: Query type: "auto", "whois", or "rdap". "rdap" is only supported in domain queries but might not be available for all domains. "auto" will always choose correctly.

remove_raw_text.description: If true, removes raw text from WHOIS output.

name: whois
